placements.title: Slug generation is guaranteed by a deterministic fallback beneath the LLM path
placements.frame: Does this expression show the pipeline still producing a valid slug and completing the commit when no explicit id is given, by falling through from an LLM-generated id to a deterministic slugify path?
placements.why: The segment states a design guarantee — when a memory arrives without an explicit id, the pipeline still resolves a slug (via LLM id-gen or deterministic slugify fallback) and commits successfully. This is a recurring behavioral guarantee about the system's robustness to missing input, not a one-time fact or measurement — it is the kind of subject future envelopes describing this fallback path or its failures/successes will keep feeding. No existing leaf (graph structure is empty) covers this theme, so it is minted fresh under the newly-minted Architecture strata.
